"""
create_and_dispatch_opencode_handoff.py

Crea un handoff completo (JSON + MD), inicializa TRACE.md y RUN_SUMMARY.md,
y despacha OpenCode en segundo plano cuando la autorización lo permite.

Este script no ejecuta comandos arbitrarios. Solo invoca:
- python scripts/start_opencode_from_handoff_async.py --run-id <run_id> ...
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import datetime
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
QUEUE_INBOX = ROOT / "docs" / "agent_queue" / "inbox"
RUNS = ROOT / "docs" / "agent_runs"


def safe_print(value: object = "") -> None:
    text = str(value)
    try:
        print(text)
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write((text + "\n").encode("utf-8", errors="replace"))


def generate_run_id() -> str:
    return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") + "_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]


def create_handoff(
    run_id: str,
    project_id: str,
    objective: str,
    handoff_body: str,
    target_agent: str,
    model: str,
    risk_level: str,
    scenario: str,
    allowed_files: list[str],
    validation_commands: list[str],
    requires_authorization: bool,
    authorization_granted: bool,
) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    QUEUE_INBOX.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    package = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "step_id": "01",
        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "project_id": project_id,
        "source_agent": "continue",
        "target_agent": target_agent,
        "scenario": scenario,
        "risk_level": risk_level,
        "information_volume": "high",
        "objective": objective,
        "handoff_body": handoff_body,
        "allowed_files": allowed_files,
        "validation_commands": validation_commands,
        "requires_authorization": requires_authorization,
        "authorization_granted": authorization_granted,
        "status": "created",
    }

    json_path = QUEUE_INBOX / f"{run_id}.json"
    md_path = QUEUE_INBOX / f"{run_id}.md"

    json_path.write_text(json.dumps(package, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    md_lines = [
        "# Handoff Package",
        "",
        f"- run_id: `{run_id}`",
        f"- project_id: `{project_id}`",
        f"- source_agent: `continue`",
        f"- target_agent: `{target_agent}`",
        f"- scenario: `{scenario}`",
        f"- risk_level: `{risk_level}`",
        f"- information_volume: `high`",
        "",
        "## Objective",
        "",
        objective,
        "",
        "## Implementation Contract (prompt for OpenCode)",
        "",
        handoff_body,
        "",
        "## Allowed Files (scope)",
        "",
    ]
    for f in allowed_files:
        md_lines.append(f"- `{f}`")

    md_lines.extend([
        "",
        "## Validation Commands",
        "",
    ])
    for cmd in validation_commands:
        md_lines.append(f"- `{cmd}`")

    md_lines.extend([
        "",
        "## Authorization",
        "",
        f"- requires_authorization: `{requires_authorization}`",
        f"- authorization_granted: `{authorization_granted}`",
        "",
        "## Status",
        "",
        "created",
    ])

    md_path.write_text("\n".join(md_lines), encoding="utf-8")

    return json_path, md_path


def create_run_artifacts(run_id: str, target_agent: str, model: str) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    run_dir = RUNS / run_id
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    trace_path = run_dir / "TRACE.md"
    summary_path = run_dir / "RUN_SUMMARY.md"

    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")

    trace_path.write_text(
        f"# TRACE\n\n"
        f"- run_id: `{run_id}`\n"
        f"- created_at: `{timestamp}`\n"
        f"- target_agent: `{target_agent}`\n"
        f"- model: `{model}`\n"
        f"- source: `create_and_dispatch_opencode_handoff`\n"
        f"\n## {timestamp} — create_and_dispatch_opencode_handoff\n\n"
        f"- status: `handoff_created`\n"
        f"- action: `TRACE.md and RUN_SUMMARY.md initialized`\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    summary_path.write_text(
        f"# RUN_SUMMARY\n\n"
        f"- run_id: `{run_id}`\n"
        f"- updated_at: `{timestamp}`\n"
        f"- total_agent_outputs: `0`\n\n"
        f"## Estado general\n\n"
        f"Handoff creado. Esperando ejecución de agentes.\n\n"
        f"## Transparencia del proceso\n\n"
        f"Este resumen permite revisar qué agente intervino, qué modelo se usó, qué estado reportó y cuál fue el aporte registrado.\n\n"
        f"Para mayor detalle, revisar `TRACE.md` y los archivos en `agent_outputs/`.\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    return trace_path, summary_path


def dispatch_opencode(run_id: str, target_agent: str, model: str) -> dict:
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        str(ROOT / "scripts" / "start_opencode_from_handoff_async.py"),
        "--run-id",
        run_id,
        "--agent",
        target_agent,
        "--model",
        model,
        "--prompt",
        (
            "Lee el archivo de handoff adjunto. Modo: BUILD AUTORIZADO dentro del alcance. "
            "Implementa según el contrato del handoff. "
            "Responde con un JSON corto con estas claves: status, agent, model, file_read, summary, next_action."
        ),
    ]

    completed = subprocess.run(
        command,
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        timeout=30,
    )

    try:
        parsed = json.loads(completed.stdout.strip()) if completed.stdout.strip() else {}
    except Exception:
        parsed = {"raw_stdout": completed.stdout, "raw_stderr": completed.stderr}

    return {
        "ok": completed.returncode == 0,
        "returncode": completed.returncode,
        "parsed": parsed,
        "stdout": completed.stdout,
        "stderr": completed.stderr,
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--project-id", default="orchestrator")
    parser.add_argument("--objective", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--handoff-body", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--target-agent", default="builder")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default="opencode-go/kimi-k2.6")
    parser.add_argument("--risk-level", default="medium")
    parser.add_argument("--scenario", default="implementation")
    parser.add_argument("--allowed-files", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--validation-commands", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--requires-authorization", type=lambda x: x.lower() == "true", default=True)
    parser.add_argument("--authorization-granted", type=lambda x: x.lower() == "true", default=False)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_id = args.run_id or generate_run_id()

    allowed_files = [f.strip() for f in args.allowed_files.split(",") if f.strip()]
    validation_commands = [c.strip() for c in args.validation_commands.split(",") if c.strip()]

    json_path, md_path = create_handoff(
        run_id=run_id,
        project_id=args.project_id,
        objective=args.objective,
        handoff_body=args.handoff_body,
        target_agent=args.target_agent,
        model=args.model,
        risk_level=args.risk_level,
        scenario=args.scenario,
        allowed_files=allowed_files,
        validation_commands=validation_commands,
        requires_authorization=args.requires_authorization,
        authorization_granted=args.authorization_granted,
    )

    trace_path, summary_path = create_run_artifacts(run_id, args.target_agent, args.model)

    if args.requires_authorization and not args.authorization_granted:
        status = "waiting_authorization"
        dispatch_result = None
        user_message = (
            f"Handoff creado para run `{run_id}`. "
            f"Requiere autorización humana antes de despachar OpenCode. "
            f"Cuando estés listo, invoca la herramienta nuevamente con authorization_granted=true."
        )
    else:
        status = "dispatched"
        dispatch_result = dispatch_opencode(run_id, args.target_agent, args.model)
        user_message = (
            f"Handoff creado y OpenCode despachado para run `{run_id}`. "
            f"Puedes consultar el estado con la herramienta `check_opencode_run_status`."
        )

    result = {
        "ok": True,
        "status": status,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "handoff_json_path": str(json_path),
        "handoff_md_path": str(md_path),
        "run_dir": str(RUNS / run_id),
        "trace_path": str(trace_path),
        "summary_path": str(summary_path),
        "target_agent": args.target_agent,
        "model": args.model,
        "next_tool": "check_opencode_run_status",
        "user_message": user_message,
    }

    if dispatch_result is not None:
        result["dispatch"] = dispatch_result

    safe_print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
